This lesson builds the three everyday verbs — **go** (راح), **come** (جه) and **return** (رجع) — plus the basic words for *near* and *far* and the prepositions you need to say where you're heading. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How movement works

**Three tense markers.** Egyptian Arabic glues a prefix onto the verb to mark tense. The present takes **بـ (be-)** for a habit or an action happening now (*baru7* = "I go / I'm going"). The future takes **هـ (ha-)** (*haru7* = "I'll go"). The past has no prefix — it uses endings instead (*ro7t* = "I went").

**The three verbs are three different shapes,** and the shape tells you what to expect. راح (go) is a **hollow verb** — its middle root letter (و) shifts around, so *ro7t* ("I went") barely resembles *ra7* ("he went"). جه (come) is **irregular** — its present ييجي looks unrelated to its past جه, so just memorise both. رجع (return) is a **regular sound verb** — the stem stays put (*rege3* / *yirga3*), making it the easiest of the three.

**The participle — your most useful shortcut.** Instead of the full present, Egyptians very often use an adjective-like form to say "(I'm) on my way": **رايح (raye7)** going, **جاي (gayy)** coming, **راجع (rage3)** heading back. It agrees in gender and number, and it's how you actually say "I'm coming!" — *ana gayy!*

**Saying where.** Use **لـ (le)** = "to", or just drop in the bare place (*raye7 esh-sho8l* = "going to work"). **من (men)** = "from".

## Examples

The same verb across the three tenses.

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا بروح الشغل كل يوم</summary>
<span class="fr">ana baru7 esh-sho8l kol yom</span>
<span class="en">I go to work every day (habit — بـ)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا هروح الشغل بكرة</summary>
<span class="fr">ana haru7 esh-sho8l bukra</span>
<span class="en">I'll go to work tomorrow (future — هـ)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا رحت الشغل إمبارح</summary>
<span class="fr">ana ro7t esh-sho8l embare7</span>
<span class="en">I went to work yesterday (past — endings)</span>
</details>

## To go — راح — ra7

**Root:** ر-و-ح (r-w-7) — hollow verb

| Present | Future | Past |
|---|---|---|
| أنا بروح - ana baru7 | أنا هروح - ana haru7 | أنا رحت - ana ro7t |
| إنت بتروح - inta bitru7 | إنت هتروح - inta hatru7 | إنت رحت - inta ro7t |
| إنتِ بتروحي - inti bitru7i | إنتِ هتروحي - inti hatru7i | إنتِ رحتي - inti ro7ti |
| هو بيروح - huwwa biyru7 | هو هيروح - huwwa hayru7 | هو راح - huwwa ra7 |
| هي بتروح - hiyya bitru7 | هي هتروح - hiyya hatru7 | هي راحت - hiyya ra7et |
| إحنا بنروح - e7na binru7 | إحنا هنروح - e7na hanru7 | إحنا رحنا - e7na ro7na |
| إنتو بتروحوا - intu bitru7u | إنتو هتروحوا - intu hatru7u | إنتو رحتوا - intu ro7tu |
| هم بيروحوا - humma biyru7u | هم هيروحوا - humma hayru7u | هم راحوا - humma ra7u |

## To come — جه — geh

**Root:** ج-ي-ء (g-y-2) — irregular verb

| Present | Future | Past |
|---|---|---|
| أنا باجي - ana bagi | أنا هاجي - ana hagi | أنا جيت - ana geet |
| إنت بتيجي - inta bitigi | إنت هتيجي - inta hatigi | إنت جيت - inta geet |
| إنتِ بتيجي - inti bitigi | إنتِ هتيجي - inti hatigi | إنتِ جيتي - inti geeti |
| هو بييجي - huwwa biyigi | هو هييجي - huwwa hayigi | هو جه - huwwa geh |
| هي بتيجي - hiyya bitigi | هي هتيجي - hiyya hatigi | هي جت - hiyya gat |
| إحنا بنيجي - e7na binigi | إحنا هنيجي - e7na hanigi | إحنا جينا - e7na geena |
| إنتو بتيجوا - intu bitigu | إنتو هتيجوا - intu hatigu | إنتو جيتوا - intu geetu |
| هم بييجوا - humma biyigu | هم هييجوا - humma hayigu | هم جم - humma gum |

## To return — رجع — rege3

**Root:** ر-ج-ع (r-g-3) — regular verb

| Present | Future | Past |
|---|---|---|
| أنا برجع - ana barga3 | أنا هرجع - ana harga3 | أنا رجعت - ana rege3t |
| إنت بترجع - inta bitirga3 | إنت هترجع - inta hatirga3 | إنت رجعت - inta rege3t |
| إنتِ بترجعي - inti bitirga3i | إنتِ هترجعي - inti hatirga3i | إنتِ رجعتي - inti rege3ti |
| هو بيرجع - huwwa biyirga3 | هو هيرجع - huwwa hayirga3 | هو رجع - huwwa rege3 |
| هي بترجع - hiyya bitirga3 | هي هترجع - hiyya hatirga3 | هي رجعت - hiyya reg3et |
| إحنا بنرجع - e7na binirga3 | إحنا هنرجع - e7na hanirga3 | إحنا رجعنا - e7na rege3na |
| إنتو بترجعوا - intu bitirga3u | إنتو هترجعوا - intu hatirga3u | إنتو رجعتوا - intu rege3tu |
| هم بيرجعوا - humma biyirga3u | هم هيرجعوا - humma hayirga3u | هم رجعوا - humma reg3u |

## The participle: "on my way"

This replaces the full present in everyday speech. It agrees with the speaker in gender and number.

| Verb | Participle (m. / f. / pl.) - franco | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| راح | رايح / رايحة / رايحين - raye7 / ray7a / ray7een | going / on the way to |
| جه | جاي / جاية / جايين - gayy / gayya / gayyeen | coming / on the way |
| رجع | راجع / راجعة / راجعين - rage3 / rag3a / rag3een | returning / on the way back |

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا جاي!</summary>
<span class="fr">ana gayy!</span>
<span class="en">I'm coming! (right now)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>إحنا راجعين البيت</summary>
<span class="fr">e7na rag3een el-bet</span>
<span class="en">we're on our way back home</span>
</details>

## Place words: here, there, near, far

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| هنا - hena | here |
| هناك - henak | there / over there |
| قريب - 2orayyeb | near / close |
| بعيد - be3eed | far |

> For "way over there", say **هناك بعيد (henak be3eed)** — literally "there, far".

## Prepositions of movement

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| لـ - le | to |
| من - men | from |
| في - fi | in / at |
| على - 3ala | to / onto / at |
| لحد - le7add | up to / until |

## Time adverbs

Mix these in to set the tense.

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| دلوقتي - delwa2ti | now |
| النهارده - en-naharda | today |
| بكرة - bukra | tomorrow |
| إمبارح - embare7 | yesterday |
| بعدين - ba3dein | later |
| من شوية - min shuwayya | a little while ago |
| بعد شوية - ba3d shuwayya | in a little while |
| الأسبوع اللي فات - el-osbo3 elli fat | last week |
| الأسبوع الجاي - el-osbo3 el-gay | next week |
| بالليل - bel-leil | at night |

## Dialogue: "Where are you going?"

Karim catches Mona on her way out.

<span class="rotulo">كريم — Karim</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>رايحة فين يا منى؟</summary>
<span class="fr">ray7a feen ya Mona?</span>
<span class="en">Where are you going, Mona?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">منى — Mona</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>رايحة الشغل. إنت جاي معايا؟</summary>
<span class="fr">ray7a esh-sho8l. inta gayy ma3aya?</span>
<span class="en">I'm going to work. Are you coming with me?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">كريم — Karim</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>لأ، أنا هروح بعدين. الشغل بعيد؟</summary>
<span class="fr">la2, ana haru7 ba3dein. esh-sho8l be3eed?</span>
<span class="en">No, I'll go later. Is work far?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">منى — Mona</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>لأ، قريب من البيت.</summary>
<span class="fr">la2, 2orayyeb men el-bet.</span>
<span class="en">No, it's near the house.</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">كريم — Karim</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>هترجعي امتى؟</summary>
<span class="fr">hatirga3i emta?</span>
<span class="en">When will you come back?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">منى — Mona</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>هرجع بالليل.</summary>
<span class="fr">harga3 bel-leil.</span>
<span class="en">I'll come back at night.</span>
</details>

## Exercises

Try each one out loud first, then tap **Show answer**.

### Exercise 1 — Conjugate

Give the right form for the pronoun and tense in brackets.

**1.** هو + راح *(future)*

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">هيروح</span>
<span class="fr">huwwa hayru7</span>
</details>

**2.** أنا + جه *(past)*

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">جيت</span>
<span class="fr">ana geet</span>
</details>

**3.** إحنا + رجع *(present)*

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">بنرجع</span>
<span class="fr">e7na binirga3</span>
</details>

**4.** إنتِ + راح *(present)*

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">بتروحي</span>
<span class="fr">inti bitru7i</span>
</details>

**5.** هي + رجع *(past)*

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">رجعت</span>
<span class="fr">hiyya reg3et</span>
</details>

**6.** هم + جه *(future)*

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">هييجوا</span>
<span class="fr">humma hayigu</span>
</details>

### Exercise 2 — Translate into Arabic

**1.** I'm going to work now.

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">أنا رايح الشغل دلوقتي</span>
<span class="fr">ana raye7 esh-sho8l delwa2ti</span>
</details>

**2.** Work is far from the house.

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">الشغل بعيد من البيت</span>
<span class="fr">esh-sho8l be3eed men el-bet</span>
</details>

**3.** We'll come back next week.

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">إحنا هنرجع الأسبوع الجاي</span>
<span class="fr">e7na hanirga3 el-osbo3 el-gay</span>
</details>

**4.** I'm coming!

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">أنا جاي!</span>
<span class="fr">ana gayy!</span>
</details>
